rows.source_ko: Chapter 1 General Provisions
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Public Disclosure of Real Estate Prices and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Public Disclosure of Real Estate Prices and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Chapter 2 Public Notice of Land Prices
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Public Notice of Land Prices

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Submission of Opinions by Owners of Standard Land) The submission of opinions pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto .
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Submission of Opinions by Owners of Standard Land) The submission of opinions pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto .

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Report on Survey and Evaluation of Standard Land Prices) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the following matters:
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Report on Survey and Evaluation of Standard Land Prices) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. Location, area, and land category in official records
rows.text_en: 1. Location, area, and land category in official records

rows.source_ko: 2. Geographical Location
rows.text_en: 2. Geographical Location

rows.source_ko: 3. Land Use Status
rows.text_en: 3. Land Use Status

rows.source_ko: 4. Land use zones pursuant to Article 2, Item 15 of the Act on Planning and Utilization of National Land (hereinafter referred to as “land use zones”)
rows.text_en: 4. Land use zones pursuant to Article 2, Item 15 of the Act on Planning and Utilization of National Land (hereinafter referred to as “land use zones”)

rows.source_ko: 5. Surrounding Environment
rows.text_en: 5. Surrounding Environment

rows.source_ko: 6. Road and Traffic Environment
rows.text_en: 6. Road and Traffic Environment

rows.source_ko: 7. Land shape and topography
rows.text_en: 7. Land shape and topography

rows.source_ko: ② An appraisal corporation, etc. commissioned to investigate and evaluate the officially assessed land price of standard plots pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 5 of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) (referring to an appraisal corporation, etc. pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Act on Appraisal and Appraisers ) shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, an investigation and evaluation report in the form of Annex 2 , attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 24, 2020>
rows.text_en: ② An appraisal corporation, etc. commissioned to investigate and evaluate the officially assessed land price of standard plots pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 5 of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) (referring to an appraisal corporation, etc. pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 4 of the Act on Appraisal and Appraisers ) shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, an investigation and evaluation report in the form of Annex 2 , attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 24, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. Regional Analysis Report
rows.text_en: 1. Regional Analysis Report

rows.source_ko: 2. Standard land survey details and price appraisal opinion prepared for each standard land in accordance with Form No. 3
rows.text_en: 2. Standard land survey details and price appraisal opinion prepared for each standard land in accordance with Form No. 3

rows.source_ko: 3. Report on the Results of Hearing Opinions prepared in accordance with Form No. 4 [The results of hearing the opinions of the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head (referring to the District Head of an autonomous district; hereinafter the same) pursuant to Article 8, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be recorded]
rows.text_en: 3. Report on the Results of Hearing Opinions prepared in accordance with Form No. 4 [The results of hearing the opinions of the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head (referring to the District Head of an autonomous district; hereinafter the same) pursuant to Article 8, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be recorded]

rows.source_ko: 4. Drawing indicating the location of the standard land
rows.text_en: 4. Drawing indicating the location of the standard land

rows.source_ko: 5. Other documents necessary for verifying facts
rows.text_en: 5. Other documents necessary for verifying facts

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Application for Objection to Standard Land Price Announcement) The application for objection pursuant to Article 12 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 5 .
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Objection to Standard Land Price Announcement) The application for objection pursuant to Article 12 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 5 .

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Issuance of Confirmation Certificate of Individually Assessed Land Price) ① Any person who wishes to obtain confirmation of an individually assessed land price determined and publicly announced pursuant to Article 10 of the Act may apply for confirmation of the individually assessed land price to the relevant Mayor, County Governor, or District Head (including an application by electronic document). <Amended June 24, 2020>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Issuance of Confirmation Certificate of Individually Assessed Land Price) ① Any person who wishes to obtain confirmation of an individually assessed land price determined and publicly announced pursuant to Article 10 of the Act may apply for confirmation of the individually assessed land price to the relevant Mayor, County Governor, or District Head (including an application by electronic document). <Amended June 24, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② The mayor, county governor, or district head shall issue a confirmation certificate to the applicant upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1.
rows.text_en: ② The mayor, county governor, or district head shall issue a confirmation certificate to the applicant upon receiving an application pursuant to Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ③ The application for confirmation under Paragraph 1 and the confirmation certificate under Paragraph 2 shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form .
rows.text_en: ③ The application for confirmation under Paragraph 1 and the confirmation certificate under Paragraph 2 shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ④ When a mayor, county governor, or district head issues a confirmation certificate pursuant to paragraph 2, they may collect a fee from the applicant as determined by the ordinance of the relevant city, county, or district (referring to a district that is an autonomous district) .
rows.text_en: ④ When a mayor, county governor, or district head issues a confirmation certificate pursuant to paragraph 2, they may collect a fee from the applicant as determined by the ordinance of the relevant city, county, or district (referring to a district that is an autonomous district) .

rows.source_ko: 제6조(개별공시지가의 검증의뢰) ① 영 제18조제1항에서 “지가현황도면”이란 해당 연도의 산정지가, 전년도의 개별공시지가 및 해당 연도의 표준지공시지가가 필지별로 기재된 도면을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Request for Verification of Individually Assessed Land Prices) ① In Article 18 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, “land price status map” refers to a map in which the assessed land price for the relevant year, the individually assessed land price for the previous year, and the standard land price for the relevant year are listed by parcel.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제18조제1항에서 “지가조사자료”란 개별토지가격의 산정조서 및 그 밖에 토지이용계획에 관한 자료를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 18 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , “land price survey data” refers to the calculation statement of individual land prices and other data regarding land use plans.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(개별토지 소유자 등의 의견제출) 영 제19조제2항에 따른 개별토지가격에 대한 의견제출은 별지 제7호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Submission of Opinions by Individual Land Owners, etc.) The submission of opinions regarding individual land prices pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 7 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제8조(개별공시지가 이의신청서) 영 제22조제1항에 따른 이의신청서는 별지 제8호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Application for Objection to Individually Assessed Land Price) The application for objection pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 8 .

rows.source_ko: 제9조(증표 및 허가증) ① 법 제13조제4항(법 제15조제3항, 제16조제7항, 제18조제8항, 제20조제7항 및 제22조제9항에 따라 준용하는 경우를 포함한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)에 따른 증표는 공무원증, 「감정평가 및 감정평가사에 관한 법률」에 따른 감정평가사 자격증 또는 「한국부동산원법」에 따른 한국부동산원(이하 “부동산원”이라 한다)의 직원증으로 한다. <개정 2020. 12. 11.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Identification and Permit) ① The identification pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 4 of the Act (as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 3, Article 16, Paragraph 7, Article 18, Paragraph 8, Article 20, Paragraph 7, and Article 22, Paragraph 9 of the Act; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) shall be a public official identification card, a certified appraiser qualification certificate pursuant to the Act on Appraisal and Appraisers, or an employee identification card of the Korea Real Estate Institute pursuant to the Korea Real Estate Institute Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Real Estate Institute”). <Amended Dec. 11, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제13조제4항에 따른 허가증은 별지 제9호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The permit pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 4 of the Act is in the form of Annex No. 9 .

rows.source_ko: 제3장 주택가격의 공시
rows.text_en: Chapter 3 Public Announcement of Housing Prices

rows.source_ko: 제10조(표준주택 소유자의 의견제출) 법 제16조제7항에서 준용하는 법 제3조제2항에 따른 표준주택가격에 대한 의견제출은 별지 제10호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Submission of Opinions by Owners of Standard Housing) The submission of opinions regarding standard housing prices pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 2 of the Act, which is applied mutatis mutandis in Article 16, Paragraph 7 of the Act , shall be in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제11조(표준주택가격 조사ㆍ산정보고서) ① 영 제30조제1항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Report on Survey and Calculation of Standard Housing Prices) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 30 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 주택의 소재지, 공부상 지목 및 대지면적
rows.text_en: 1. Location of the house, registered land category, and site area

rows.source_ko: 2. 주택 대지의 용도지역
rows.text_en: 2. Zoning of residential land

rows.source_ko: 3. 도로접면
rows.text_en: 3. Road frontage

rows.source_ko: 4. 대지 형상
rows.text_en: 4. Site Shape

rows.source_ko: 5. 주건물 구조 및 층수
rows.text_en: 5. Main building structure and number of floors

rows.source_ko: 6. 「건축법」 제22조에 따른 사용승인(이하 “사용승인”이라 한다)연도
rows.text_en: 6. Year of approval for use pursuant to Article 22 of the Building Act (hereinafter referred to as “approval for use”)

rows.source_ko: 7. 주위 환경
rows.text_en: 7. Surrounding Environment

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제16조제4항에 따라 표준주택가격 조사ㆍ산정을 의뢰받은 부동산원은 영 제30조제1항에 따라 별지 제11호서식의 조사ㆍ산정보고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국토교통부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2020. 12. 11.>
rows.text_en: ② The Real Estate Office that has been commissioned to investigate and calculate standard housing prices pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport , in accordance with Article 30, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , the investigation and calculation report in Form No. 11 of the Attached Form, with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs attached. <Amended Dec. 11, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 지역분석조서
rows.text_en: 1. Regional Analysis Report

rows.source_ko: 2. 별지 제12호서식에 따라 표준주택별로 작성한 표준주택 조사사항 및 가격산정의견서
rows.text_en: 2. Standard Housing Survey Details and Price Calculation Opinion Form prepared for each standard housing in accordance with Form No. 12

rows.source_ko: 3. 별지 제13호서식에 따라 작성한 의견청취결과서(영 제30조제2항 및 제3항에 따라 시장ㆍ군수 또는 구청장의 의견을 들은 결과를 기재한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Report on the Results of Opinion Hearing Prepared in accordance with Form No. 13 ( recording the results of hearing the opinions of the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head in accordance with Article 30, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Enforcement Decree )

rows.source_ko: 4. 표준주택의 위치를 표시한 도면
rows.text_en: 4. Drawing showing the location of the standard house

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 사실 확인에 필요한 서류
rows.text_en: 5. Other documents necessary for verifying facts

rows.source_ko: 제12조(표준주택가격에 대한 이의신청) 법 제16조제7항에서 준용하는 법 제7조에 따른 표준주택가격에 대한 이의신청은 별지 제14호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Objection to Standard Housing Price) An objection to the standard housing price pursuant to Article 7 of the Act, which is applied mutatis mutandis in Article 16 , Paragraph 7 of the Act , shall be in accordance with Form No. 14 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제13조(개별주택가격 확인서의 발급) 법 제17조에 따라 결정ㆍ공시된 개별주택가격의 확인에 관하여는 제5조를 준용한다. 이 경우 확인 신청 및 확인서는 별지 제15호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Issuance of Confirmation Certificate of Individual Housing Price) Article 5 shall apply to the confirmation of individual housing prices determined and publicly announced pursuant to Article 17 of the Act. In this case, the application for confirmation and the confirmation certificate shall be in accordance with Form No. 15 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제14조(개별주택가격의 검증의뢰) ① 영 제36조제1항에서 “가격현황도면”이란 해당 연도에 산정된 개별주택가격, 전년도의 개별주택가격 및 해당 연도의 표준주택가격이 주택별로 기재된 도면을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Request for Verification of Individual Housing Prices) ① In Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, “price status map” refers to a map in which the individual housing prices calculated for the relevant year, the individual housing prices of the previous year, and the standard housing prices of the relevant year are listed for each house.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제36조제1항에서 “가격조사자료”란 개별주택가격의 산정조서 및 그 밖에 토지이용계획에 관한 자료를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , “price survey data” refers to the calculation statement of individual housing prices and other data regarding land use plans.

rows.source_ko: 제15조(개별주택 소유자 등의 의견제출) 영 제37조에 따른 개별주택가격에 대한 의견제출은 별지 제16호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Submission of Opinions by Owners of Individual Houses, etc.) The submission of opinions regarding individual house prices pursuant to Article 37 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 16 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제16조(개별주택가격에 대한 이의신청) 법 제17조제8항에서 준용하는 법 제7조에 따른 개별주택가격에 대한 이의신청은 별지 제17호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Objection to Individual Housing Price) An objection to individual housing price pursuant to Article 7 of the Act , which is applied mutatis mutandis in Article 17 , Paragraph 8 of the Act , shall be in accordance with Form No. 17 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제17조(공동주택가격 확인서의 발급) 법 제18조에 따라 결정ㆍ공시된 공동주택가격의 확인에 관하여는 제5조를 준용한다. 이 경우 확인 신청 및 확인서는 별지 제18호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Issuance of Confirmation Certificate of Apartment Housing Price) Article 5 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the confirmation of apartment housing prices determined and publicly announced pursuant to Article 18 of the Act. In this case, the application for confirmation and the confirmation certificate shall be in accordance with Form No. 18 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제18조(공동주택소유자 등의 의견제출) 영 제42조에 따른 공동주택가격에 대한 의견제출은 별지 제19호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Submission of Opinions by Owners of Multi-Family Housing, etc.) The submission of opinions regarding the price of multi-family housing pursuant to Article 42 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 19 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제19조(공동주택가격 조사ㆍ산정보고서) ① 영 제46조제1항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Report on Survey and Calculation of Apartment Prices) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 46 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 공동주택의 소재지, 단지명, 동명 및 호명
rows.text_en: 1. Location, complex name, building name, and unit name of the multi-unit housing

rows.source_ko: 2. 공동주택의 면적 및 공시가격
rows.text_en: 2. Area and Officially Assessed Price of Multi-unit Housing

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 공동주택가격 조사ㆍ산정에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Other matters necessary for the investigation and calculation of multi-unit housing prices

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제18조제6항에 따라 공동주택가격 조사ㆍ산정을 의뢰받은 부동산원은 영 제46조제1항에 따라 개별 공동주택가격 외에 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 조사ㆍ산정보고서를 책자 또는 전자정보의 형태로 국토교통부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2020. 12. 11.>
rows.text_en: ② The Real Estate Agency, having been commissioned to investigate and calculate the price of multi-unit housing pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 6 of the Act , shall submit to the Minister of Land , Infrastructure and Transport, in the form of a booklet or electronic information, an investigation and calculation report containing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs in addition to the individual price of multi-unit housing, in accordance with Article 46, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree. <Amended Dec. 11, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 공동주택 분포현황
rows.text_en: 1. Current Status of Multi-Family Housing Distribution

rows.source_ko: 2. 공동주택가격 변동률
rows.text_en: 2. Rate of change in apartment prices

rows.source_ko: 3. 공동주택가격 총액 및 면적당 단가ㆍ평균가격
rows.text_en: 3. Total price of multi-unit housing and unit price/average price per area

rows.source_ko: 4. 공동주택가격 상위ㆍ하위 현황
rows.text_en: 4. Status of Top and Bottom Multi-unit Housing Prices

rows.source_ko: 5. 의견제출 및 이의신청 접수현황 및 처리현황
rows.text_en: 5. Status of Receipt and Processing of Opinions and Objections

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 공동주택가격에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters concerning the price of multi-unit housing

rows.source_ko: 제20조(공동주택가격에 대한 이의신청) 법 제18조제8항에서 준용하는 법 제7조에 따른 공동주택가격에 대한 이의신청은 별지 제20호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Objection to the Price of Multi-unit Housing) An objection to the price of multi-unit housing pursuant to Article 7 of the Act , which is applied mutatis mutandis in Article 18, Paragraph 8 of the Act , shall be in accordance with Form No. 20 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제4장 비주거용 부동산가격의 공시
rows.text_en: Chapter 4 Public Announcement of Non-Residential Real Estate Prices

rows.source_ko: 제21조(비주거용 표준부동산 소유자의 의견제출) 법 제20조제7항에서 준용하는 법 제3조제2항에 따른 비주거용 표준부동산가격에 대한 의견제출은 별지 제21호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Submission of Opinions by Owners of Non-Residential Standard Real Estate) The submission of opinions regarding the price of non-residential standard real estate pursuant to Article 3 , Paragraph 2 of the Act , which is applied mutatis mutandis in Article 20 , Paragraph 7 of the Act , shall be in accordance with Form No. 21 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제22조(비주거용 표준부동산가격 조사ㆍ산정보고서) ① 영 제53조제1항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Report on Survey and Calculation of Standard Real Estate Prices for Non-Residential Use) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 부동산의 소재지, 공부상 지목 및 대지면적
rows.text_en: 1. Location of the real estate, registered land category, and building area

rows.source_ko: 2. 대지의 용도지역
rows.text_en: 2. Land Use Zones

rows.source_ko: 3. 도로접면
rows.text_en: 3. Road frontage

rows.source_ko: 4. 대지 형상
rows.text_en: 4. Site Shape

rows.source_ko: 5. 건물 용도 및 연면적
rows.text_en: 5. Building Use and Gross Floor Area

rows.source_ko: 6. 주건물 구조 및 층수
rows.text_en: 6. Main Building Structure and Number of Floors

rows.source_ko: 7. 사용승인연도
rows.text_en: 7. Year of approval for use

rows.source_ko: 8. 주위 환경
rows.text_en: 8. Surrounding Environment

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제20조제4항에 따라 비주거용 표준부동산가격의 조사ㆍ산정을 의뢰받은 자는 영 제53조제1항에 따라 별지 제22호서식의 조사ㆍ산정보고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국토교통부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A person who has been commissioned to investigate and calculate the standard price of non-residential real estate pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, in accordance with Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, an investigation and calculation report in Form No. 22 of the Appendix, with the following documents attached.

rows.source_ko: 1. 지역분석조서
rows.text_en: 1. Regional Analysis Report

rows.source_ko: 2. 별지 제23호서식에 따라 비주거용 표준부동산별로 작성한 비주거용 표준부동산 조사사항 및 가격산정의견서
rows.text_en: 2. Non-residential standard real estate survey details and price assessment opinion prepared for each non-residential standard real estate in accordance with Form No. 23

rows.source_ko: 3. 별지 제24호서식에 따라 작성한 의견청취결과서(영 제53조제2항 및 제3항에 따라 시장ㆍ군수 또는 구청장의 의견을 들은 결과를 기재한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Report on the Results of Opinion Hearing Prepared in accordance with Form No. 24 ( recording the results of hearing the opinions of the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head in accordance with Article 53, Paragraphs 2 and 3 of the Enforcement Decree )

rows.source_ko: 4. 비주거용 표준부동산의 위치를 표시한 도면
rows.text_en: 4. Drawing indicating the location of standard non-residential real estate

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 사실 확인에 필요한 서류
rows.text_en: 5. Other documents necessary for verifying facts

rows.source_ko: 제23조(비주거용 표준부동산가격에 대한 이의신청) 법 제20조제7항에서 준용하는 법 제7조에 따른 비주거용 표준부동산가격에 대한 이의신청은 별지 제25호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Objection to Standard Real Estate Prices for Non-Residential Use) An objection to the standard real estate prices for non-residential use pursuant to Article 7 of the Act , which is applied mutatis mutandis in Article 20, Paragraph 7 of the Act , shall be in accordance with Form No. 25 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제24조(비주거용 개별부동산가격 확인서의 발급) 법 제21조에 따라 결정ㆍ공시된 비주거용 개별부동산가격의 확인에 관하여는 제5조를 준용한다. 이 경우 확인 신청 및 확인서는 별지 제26호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Issuance of Confirmation Certificate for Non-Residential Individual Real Estate Prices) Article 5 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the confirmation of non-residential individual real estate prices determined and publicly announced pursuant to Article 21 of the Act. In this case, the application for confirmation and the confirmation certificate shall be in accordance with Form No. 26 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제25조(비주거용 개별부동산가격의 검증의뢰) ① 영 제60조제1항에서 “가격현황도면”이란 해당 연도에 산정된 비주거용 개별부동산가격, 전년도의 비주거용 개별부동산가격 및 해당 연도의 비주거용 표준부동산가격이 비주거용 부동산별로 기재된 도면을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Request for Verification of Individual Non-Residential Real Estate Prices) ① In Article 60 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, “price status map” refers to a map in which the individual non-residential real estate prices calculated for the relevant year, the individual non-residential real estate prices of the previous year, and the standard non-residential real estate prices of the relevant year are listed by non-residential real estate.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제60조제1항에서 “가격조사자료”란 비주거용 개별부동산가격의 산정조서 및 그 밖에 토지이용계획에 관한 자료를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 60 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , “price survey data” refers to the calculation statement of individual non-residential real estate prices and other data regarding land use plans.

rows.source_ko: 제26조(비주거용 일반부동산 소유자 등의 의견제출) 영 제61조에 따른 비주거용 개별부동산가격에 대한 의견제출은 별지 제27호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Submission of Opinions by Owners, etc. of Non-Residential General Real Estate) The submission of opinions regarding the price of individual non-residential real estate pursuant to Article 61 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 27 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제27조(비주거용 개별부동산가격에 대한 이의신청) 법 제21조제8항에서 준용하는 법 제11조에 따른 비주거용 개별부동산가격에 대한 이의신청은 별지 제28호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Objection to the price of individual non-residential real estate) An objection to the price of individual non-residential real estate pursuant to Article 11 of the Act , which is applied mutatis mutandis in Article 21 , Paragraph 8 of the Act , shall be in accordance with Form No. 28 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제28조(비주거용 집합부동산가격 확인서의 발급) 법 제22조에 따라 결정ㆍ공시된 비주거용 집합부동산가격의 확인에 관하여는 제5조를 준용한다. 이 경우 확인 신청 및 확인서는 별지 제29호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Issuance of Confirmation Certificate for Non-Residential Collective Real Estate Prices) Article 5 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the confirmation of non-residential collective real estate prices determined and publicly announced pursuant to Article 22 of the Act . In this case, the application for confirmation and the confirmation certificate shall be in accordance with Form No. 29 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제29조(비주거용 집합부동산 소유자 등의 의견제출) 영 제66조에 따른 비주거용 집합부동산가격에 대한 의견제출은 별지 제30호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Submission of Opinions by Owners, etc. of Non-Residential Collective Real Estate) The submission of opinions regarding the price of non-residential collective real estate pursuant to Article 66 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 30 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제30조(비주거용 집합부동산가격 조사ㆍ산정보고서) ① 영 제69조제2항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 30 (Report on Survey and Calculation of Prices of Non-Residential Collective Real Estate) ① The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 69, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 비주거용 집합부동산의 소재지, 동명 및 호명
rows.text_en: 1. Location, Dong name, and unit name of non-residential collective real estate

rows.source_ko: 2. 비주거용 집합부동산의 면적 및 공시가격
rows.text_en: 2. Area and Officially Assessed Value of Non-Residential Collective Real Estate

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 비주거용 집합부동산의 조사ㆍ산정에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Other matters necessary for the investigation and calculation of non-residential collective real estate

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제22조제7항에 따라 비주거용 집합부동산가격 조사ㆍ산정을 의뢰받은 자는 영 제69조제2항에 따라 개별 비주거용 집합부동산가격 외에 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 조사ㆍ산정보고서를 책자 또는 전자정보의 형태로 국토교통부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A person who has been commissioned to investigate and calculate the price of non-residential collective real estate pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 7 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, in the form of a booklet or electronic information, an investigation and calculation report containing the following items in addition to the price of individual non-residential collective real estate, in accordance with Article 69, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree .

rows.source_ko: 1. 비주거용 집합부동산 분포현황
rows.text_en: 1. Current Status of Distribution of Non-Residential Collective Real Estate

rows.source_ko: 2. 비주거용 집합부동산가격 변동률
rows.text_en: 2. Price fluctuation rate of non-residential collective real estate

rows.source_ko: 3. 비주거용 집합부동산가격 총액 및 면적당 단가ㆍ평균가격
rows.text_en: 3. Total price of non-residential collective real estate and unit price/average price per area

rows.source_ko: 4. 비주거용 집합부동산가격 상위ㆍ하위 현황
rows.text_en: 4. Status of Top and Bottom Prices of Non-Residential Collective Real Estate

rows.source_ko: 5. 의견제출 및 이의신청 접수현황 및 처리현황
rows.text_en: 5. Status of Receipt and Processing of Opinions and Objections

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 비주거용 집합부동산가격에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters concerning the price of non-residential collective real estate

rows.source_ko: 제31조(비주거용 집합부동산가격에 대한 이의신청) 법 제22조제9항에서 준용하는 법 제7조에 따른 비주거용 집합부동산가격에 대한 이의신청은 별지 제31호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 31 (Objection to the Price of Non-Residential Collective Real Estate) An objection to the price of non-residential collective real estate pursuant to Article 7 of the Act , which is applied mutatis mutandis in Article 22, Paragraph 9 of the Act , shall be in accordance with Form No. 31 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제32조(자료의 공개) 국토교통부장관은 법 제26조제1항에 따라 표준지공시지가, 표준주택가격 및 공동주택가격의 주요사항에 관한 보고서를 국회에 제출하는 때에 같은 조 제2항에 따라 다음 각 호의 자료를 영 제4조에 따른 부동산공시가격시스템에 게시해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 32 (Disclosure of Data) When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport submits a report to the National Assembly regarding major matters concerning standard land prices, standard housing prices, and multi-unit housing prices pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Act, he/she shall post the data in each of the following subparagraphs on the real estate official price system pursuant to Article 4 of the Enforcement Decree pursuant to Paragraph 2 of the same Article.

rows.source_ko: 1. 부동산 유형별 종합적인 시세 반영률
rows.text_en: 1. Comprehensive market price reflection rate by real estate type

rows.source_ko: 2. 부동산 유형별 공시가격의 조사ㆍ산정 기준 및 절차
rows.text_en: 2. Standards and Procedures for Survey and Calculation of Officially Assessed Prices by Real Estate Type

rows.source_ko: 3. 부동산 공시가격 산정에 고려된 용도지역 또는 용도 등 주요 특성 및 현황
rows.text_en: 3. Major characteristics and current status, such as zoning or use, considered in the calculation of officially assessed real estate prices

rows.source_ko: 4. 부동산 공시가격 산정에 참고한 인근지역의 실거래가 및 시세자료 등 가격에 관한 자료
rows.text_en: 4. Price data, such as actual transaction prices and market price data of nearby areas, referenced in the calculation of officially assessed real estate prices
[This Article Newly Inserted Oct. 8, 2020]
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 358, Aug. 31, 2016>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 영은 2016년 9월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Decree shall enter into force on September 1, 2016.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 개정) ① 개발이익 환수에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Recovery of Development Profits are partially amended as follows:

rows.source_ko: 제8조제1항 중 “「부동산 가격공시 및 감정평가에 관한 법률」 제20조에 따라 설치된 시ㆍ군ㆍ구부동산평가위원회”를 “「부동산 가격공시에 관한 법률」 제25조에 따라 설치된 시ㆍ군ㆍ구부동산가격공시위원회”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 8, Paragraph 1, “the City/County/District Real Estate Appraisal Committee established pursuant to Article 20 of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal” shall be changed to “the City/County/District Real Estate Price Announcement Committee established pursuant to Article 25 of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices”.

rows.source_ko: ② 공동주택 분양가격의 산정 등에 관한 규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Rules on the Calculation, etc. of Sale Prices of Multi-Unit Housing are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제10조제2항 중 “「부동산 가격공시 및 감정평가에 관한 법률」 제5조제2항 및 같은 법 시행령 제7조제2항”을 “「부동산 가격공시에 관한 법률」 제3조제5항 및 같은 법 시행령 제7조제5항”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 10, Paragraph 2, “Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Act on Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal and Article 7, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act” shall be changed to “Article 3, Paragraph 5 of the Act on Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Article 7, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act”.

rows.source_ko: In Article 11, Paragraph 1, “the Act on Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal” shall be changed to “the Act on Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices”.
rows.text_en: In Article 11, Paragraph 1, “the Act on Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal” shall be changed to “the Act on Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices”.

rows.source_ko: ③ The Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and its affiliated agencies are partially amended as follows.
rows.text_en: ③ The Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and its affiliated agencies are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: In Article 8, Paragraph 11, Subparagraph 5, “Central Real Estate Appraisal Committee” shall be changed to “Central Real Estate Price Disclosure Committee.”
rows.text_en: In Article 8, Paragraph 11, Subparagraph 5, “Central Real Estate Appraisal Committee” shall be changed to “Central Real Estate Price Disclosure Committee.”

rows.source_ko: ④ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Recovery of Excess Profits from Reconstruction is amended as follows.
rows.text_en: ④ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Recovery of Excess Profits from Reconstruction is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: In the main text of Article 4, Paragraph 2, “Special Self-Governing Province/City/County/District Real Estate Appraisal Committee pursuant to Article 20 of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal” shall be changed to “City/County/District Real Estate Price Announcement Committee pursuant to Article 25 of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices”, and in the proviso of the same paragraph, “Special Self-Governing Province/City/County/District Real Estate Appraisal Committee” shall be changed to “City/County/District Real Estate Price Announcement Committee”.
rows.text_en: In the main text of Article 4, Paragraph 2, “Special Self-Governing Province/City/County/District Real Estate Appraisal Committee pursuant to Article 20 of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal” shall be changed to “City/County/District Real Estate Price Announcement Committee pursuant to Article 25 of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices”, and in the proviso of the same paragraph, “Special Self-Governing Province/City/County/District Real Estate Appraisal Committee” shall be changed to “City/County/District Real Estate Price Announcement Committee”.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Housing Act is amended as follows.
rows.text_en: ⑤ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Housing Act is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: In Article 32, Paragraph 1, “the Act on Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal” shall be changed to “the Act on Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices”.
rows.text_en: In Article 32, Paragraph 1, “the Act on Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal” shall be changed to “the Act on Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices”.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Relationship with Other Laws)  Where, at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, other laws refer to the "Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal" or its provisions, and there are corresponding provisions in this Rule, it shall be deemed that this Rule or the relevant provisions of this Rule have been referred to in place of the former "Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal" or its provisions.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Relationship with Other Laws)  Where, at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, other laws refer to the "Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal" or its provisions, and there are corresponding provisions in this Rule, it shall be deemed that this Rule or the relevant provisions of this Rule have been referred to in place of the former "Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Public Announcement of Real Estate Prices and Appraisal" or its provisions.

rows.source_ko: ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 480, Jan. 17, 2018>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 480, Jan. 17, 2018>

rows.source_ko: This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Decree No. 741, June 24, 2020>

rows.source_ko: This rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the part of Article 3, Paragraph 2, excluding the subparagraphs thereof, concerning appraisal corporations, etc., shall enter into force on July 8, 2020.
rows.text_en: This rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the part of Article 3, Paragraph 2, excluding the subparagraphs thereof, concerning appraisal corporations, etc., shall enter into force on July 8, 2020.
